parsed.main_gap: The terminal-set cardinality estimate uses an incorrect exponent, though the needed boundedness follows immediately after correcting it.

errors.description: Since D\{p} has |D|-1 primes, the valid inequality is 2^{|D|-1}≤w(D\{p}), not 2^{|D|}≤w(D\{p}). The corrected inequality still gives a uniform cardinality bound, so the proof is readily repaired.

parsed.notes: Apart from this localized off-by-one error, the support reduction, self-duality, sunflower argument, descent, finiteness of minimal supports, and final periodicity argument are coherent and complete.
